required: one exact current money or item declaration per selected reward and destination
the exact current Trainer or group inventory document and revision
the reward package exact item definition authority
forbidden: name or prose based item identity inference
mixed permission authority for one destination

money.distribution: A reward may be split across exact destinations; positive integer declarations must sum exactly to the source amount.
money.balance: Each current non-negative safe-integer balance is incremented in deterministic allocation order with overflow rejection.
money.write: Every contributing leaf write identifies one exact sheet or group-inventory revision and capacity cost zero.

items.stackMerge: Stack rewards reuse the authoritative inventory merge predicate. Exact canonical identity, cost, description, modifier, slot, and structured variant must match before quantity is merged.
items.newRows: A non-merging reward receives a deterministic settlement, reward, and destination-bound row identity.
items.definitionRule: The declaration definition authority must exactly match the reward package line; the row name must be the exact canonical item identity.
items.serializedRule: Serialized equipment is one whole equipment-section row with quantity one, revision zero, a reviewed equipment definition, and a deterministic settlement/reward-bound whole-item identity.
items.duplicateRule: Duplicate row identities or whole-item identities anywhere in a destination inventory reject the whole plan.

revisionPlan.aggregateRevision: Every changed Trainer or group destination advances exactly once regardless of how many allocations contribute.
revisionPlan.beforeAfterEvidence: Each private container write retains stable-JSON SHA-256 before and after evidence and the exact source-derived next document.
revisionPlan.staleRule: Application rechecks every current revision and before hash, planned after hash, and next revision before exposing any applicable write.
revisionPlan.atomicRule: A pending, denied, stale, capacity-exceeded, duplicate, overflowed, or definition-inconsistent plan exposes no applicable writes. P8-080 persists complete plans atomically.

completion.complete: Every non-excluded money and item line is conserved exactly across allowed declarations and has a complete private write preview.
completion.pending: Missing, under-allocated, over-allocated, or invalid whole-item distribution remains visibly pending and blocks application.
completion.denied: A denied destination retains allocation and permission evidence, produces no mutation, and blocks application.
completion.excluded: An explicitly excluded line requires no allocation or write.
completion.foreignAllocation: An existing money or item allocation not owned by this versioned provider is never replaced implicitly.

providerOwns: canonical stack merge and deterministic row creation

privacy.safeProjection: Later UI may show safe destination labels, amount, balance before and after, merged or new-row status, capacity result, and pending or denied state only.
